approval.title: Approval status
approval.intro: Whether the material may go into a garment. A released BOM can't hold a blocked one.
approval.viewOnly: You can view, not change: deciding needs the material approval right.
approval.readOnlyArchived: Read-only: the material is archived. Reactivate it to decide.

means.CONDITIONAL: Approved on a condition the people using it read.
means.BLOCKED: Not to be used: no new BOM line, no release of a revision naming it.

approval.noteHint: Optional, one line: the people who use the material read it.
approval.noteHintRequired: Required, one line of up to 1000 characters: the people who use the material read it.
approval.noteRefused: The server refused this text: check it.

held.whyBlocked: Say why the material is blocked.
held.whyCondition: Say the condition it is approved on.
held.noteLong: One line of up to 1000 characters.

reach.noStyles: Where it is used is not in your role.
reach.none: No BOM names it now: a decision changes no style.
reach.words: Used now in {styles} style(s): {drafts} draft and {released} released revision(s).
reach.noWorkOrders: Open work orders are not in your role.
reach.workOrders_one: {count} open work order makes a released one.
reach.workOrders_other: {count} open work orders make released ones.

block.title: Block {code}?
block.noLine: No new BOM line takes it.
block.drafts_one: {count} draft revision naming it cannot be released until the material is replaced or approved again.
block.drafts_other: {count} draft revisions naming it cannot be released until the material is replaced or approved again.
block.released_one: {count} released revision keeps it as it is (a released BOM is frozen).
block.released_other: {count} released revisions keep it as they are (a released BOM is frozen).
block.back: You can approve it again later; the reason stays in its history.

properties.title: Properties of its kind
properties.viewOnly: You can view, not change: your role does not change this library.
properties.readOnlyArchived: Read-only: the material is archived. Reactivate it to change it.

intro.TEXTILE: Weight, width and construction of the fabric: the garment's composition is weighed with them.
intro.PROTECTOR: What the protector is: its EN 1621 standard, type, level and size.
intro.TRIM: What the trim is made of, its finish and size, and whether it is nickel free.

hint.widthCm: The usable width of the roll, in centimetres.
hint.type: Where it protects: shoulder, elbow, back…
hint.size: The protector's size as the supplier names it.
hint.nickelFree: Metal parts in contact with the skin.

held.number: A number above 0 with at most 4 decimals.

properties.badNumber: A number above 0 with at most 4 decimals.

fibres.title: Fibres on the label
fibres.allOfficial: Each fibre is an official name of Reg. (EU) 1007/2011 Annex I.
fibres.problems_one: {count} fibre needs another name before it goes on a label.
fibres.problems_other: {count} fibres need another name before they go on a label.
fibres.notTextile: Leave it out of the composition and mark the material as of animal origin (the label's phrase).
fibres.unknown: Check it against Reg. (EU) 1007/2011 Annex I.

whereUsed.title: Where used
whereUsed.tableLabel: BOM lines that use the material

noStyles.title: Styles are not in your role
noStyles.body: Where the material is used is shown to people who read styles.

whereUsed.emptyBody: No revision of any style names this material, as a line or an alternate.
whereUsed.emptyColourBody: Pick another colour, or every colour.

tileHint.styles: Styles whose draft or released BOM names it
tileHint.released: They keep it as it is

styleChecks.title: Blocked or unapproved materials
styleChecks.intro: The materials of revision {revision}'s BOM that are blocked, approved on a condition or not reviewed yet.
styleChecks.blockedDraft_one: {count} blocked material: this revision cannot be released until it is replaced or approved again.
styleChecks.blockedDraft_other: {count} blocked materials: this revision cannot be released until they are replaced or approved again.
styleChecks.blockedReleased_one: {count} material of this released revision was blocked later: the revision keeps it; a new revision must replace it.
styleChecks.blockedReleased_other: {count} materials of this released revision were blocked later: the revision keeps them; a new revision must replace them.
styleChecks.none_one: Nothing to check: its {count} material is approved.
styleChecks.none_other: Nothing to check: its {count} materials are approved.

wait.offline: Offline — your changes are kept on this page.
wait.busy: Wait: the last change is still being saved.

tileHint.unused: No draft or released BOM names it
